name: Potbelly
disclaimer_extra: Potbelly does not publish nutrition itself -- it hands the job to Nutritionix and embeds that calculator on its own site, so these figures come from the export Potbelly points its customers at. They are computed sums over each ingredient rather than the rounded per-item figures most chains print, which is why a sandwich totals 928 rather than a tidy 930. Every named sandwich already includes white bread at its size, which is the assumption Nutritionix states, so there is no bread step when you start from one. Multigrain is within a few calories of white, but a thin-cut loaf is around a hundred less -- build from scratch to pick the bread yourself. Portions are Potbelly's own multipliers: an ingredient is stated once and served at 1.5x on a BIGS and half on a Skinny.
blurb: Build a Potbelly sandwich the way you order it -- start from A Wreck, a Turkey Breast or any Original, BIGS or Skinny, then pile on the works: hot peppers, oil, cheese and every topping, each with its real per-size portion.

categories.name: Bread & Size
categories.note: Potbelly publishes a separate figure for every size, so the bread decides which sandwiches and which portions apply. A named sandwich is listed here with its bread removed, so the loaf you pick is the one you get.

categories.name: Toppings
categories.note: Potbelly serves each topping at a set portion; use the quantity control for Light (half) or Extra.
